description:
The Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana is a flagship health assurance scheme launched by the Government of Odisha on 1st August 2018. 

The scheme was initiated to provide financial protection to the economically vulnerable sections of society in Odisha. 

It aims to ensure access to quality healthcare services for all residents of the state. 

The primary objective of the Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana is to provide health coverage of up to INR 5 lakh per family per year. 

This coverage is applicable for secondary and tertiary healthcare services. 

The scheme targets around 70 lakh families in Odisha. 

This includes families who are part of the Socio-Economic Caste Census 2011. 

Additionally, the scheme also covers families that are not included in the census but fall under the poverty line. 

The Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana provides cashless treatment in both public and empaneled private hospitals. 

The scheme covers over 1,000 procedures including surgeries, treatments, and diagnostics. 

Beneficiaries can avail of services such as cardiac surgeries, cancer treatments, and orthopedic surgeries. 

The scheme also covers pre and post-hospitalization expenses. 

The eligibility criteria for the Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana include being a resident of Odisha. 

Families must be identified as economically vulnerable based on the Socio-Economic Caste Census 2011. 

Families with an annual income of less than INR 5 lakh are eligible for the scheme. 

The scheme is also open to all women in the family. 

Women are considered the head of the family for the purpose of this scheme. 

To apply for the Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana, beneficiaries must follow a specific application process. 

The application can be made online through the official website or at designated centers. 

Applicants need to provide documents such as proof of identity and income. 

Aadhar card and income certificate are mandatory documents for the application. 

Once the application is submitted, it undergoes verification by the concerned authorities. 

The verification process typically takes about 15 days. 

Upon successful verification, beneficiaries receive a health card. 

This health card is essential for availing of the benefits under the scheme. 

The health card contains details of the family members and the coverage amount. 

Beneficiaries can use this card to access cashless treatment at empaneled hospitals. 

The disbursement of funds is done directly to the hospitals. 

This ensures that beneficiaries do not face any out-of-pocket expenses during treatment. 

The scheme is implemented by the Health and Family Welfare Department of Odisha. 

The department is responsible for monitoring and evaluating the scheme's effectiveness. 

The Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana has seen significant uptake since its launch. 

As of October 2023, over 1.5 crore beneficiaries have been enrolled under the scheme. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 1,200 crore for the financial year 2023-2024. 

This budget is aimed at expanding the coverage and improving healthcare facilities. 

The scheme also emphasizes preventive healthcare services. 

Beneficiaries are encouraged to participate in health camps and awareness programs. 

These programs focus on health education and preventive measures. 

The Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana has been instrumental in reducing the financial burden of healthcare. 

It has contributed to improving health indicators in the state. 

The scheme has also led to an increase in hospital admissions for various treatments. 

The government has partnered with various private hospitals to enhance service delivery. 

Empaneled hospitals are required to maintain quality standards. 

Regular audits are conducted to ensure compliance with the scheme's guidelines. 

The Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana has received positive feedback from beneficiaries. 

Many families have reported improved access to healthcare services. 

The scheme has also been praised for its transparency and efficiency. 

Beneficiaries can track their claims and treatment history online. 

The government is continuously working to enhance the scheme's reach. 

Awareness campaigns are conducted to educate people about the benefits. 

The Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana is a significant step towards universal health coverage in Odisha. 

It aligns with the national health mission's goals of providing accessible healthcare. 

The scheme has also inspired similar initiatives in other states. 

The success of the Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana is evident from its growing popularity. 

The government aims to further expand the scheme in the coming years. 

In conclusion, the Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana is a comprehensive health assurance scheme. 

It provides substantial financial protection to vulnerable families in Odisha. 

The scheme's focus on cashless treatment and extensive coverage makes it a vital initiative. 

With continuous improvements and expansions, it aims to ensure better health outcomes for all residents.
